add.k: Kilgrave's father, a neuroscientist in hiding
st: Albert Thompson explains Kilgrave's powers to Jessica, is forced to boost them, and dies begging her to kill his son.

files.notes: Named 'Albert' in the e08 footage and 'Albert and Louise Thompson' in e09. Professor Davies, head of Manchester's neuroscience department, names the Thompsons as professors who ran the study on children there and skipped town in '88, so University of Manchester then Independent; forced work for Kilgrave is for a person, not a group.

st: Ana Silva tries to throw Jessica out and calls Ronnie, then watches Jessica dig up her missing son Nathan under the gazebo.

files.notes: 'Ana' said by her husband in e07; surname from her son Nathan Silva. No group named on screen.

n: A man with a stolen sculpture
add.k: A man who had his half-sister beaten for a sculpture
st: Andrew Brandt has his half-sister beaten for a sculpture, shoots at Trish and Jessica, and is left tied up for the police.

files.notes: Named on a news report in e02. No group named on screen.

st: Dr. Zakarian warns Jeri her symptoms are not just a cramp, then refuses to help her end her life before ALS does.

files.notes: Unnamed in e01; 'Dr. Zakarian' and 'Anna' both said in e04. No practice or hospital named on screen, so Independent.

add.k: A jeweler who blames gifted people for her mother's death
st: Audrey Eastman hires Jessica on a fake cheating case to lure her into a trap, shoots her in the arm, and is scared off.

files.notes: Her jewelry business is never named on screen, so Independent.

st: Barbara Shlottman hires Jessica to find her daughter Hope, and is shot dead by Hope in the elevator under Kilgrave's control.

files.notes: Introduces herself by full name in e01. An accountant; no employer named, so Independent.

add.k: Hope Shlottman's father, a contractor from Omaha
st: Bob Shlottman tries to fix Jessica's broken door while hiring her to find Hope, and is shot dead by Hope in the elevator.

files.notes: 'Bob' said by his wife and 'Mr. Shlottman' by Jessica in e01. General contractor, no company named, so Independent.

st: Brian Jones turns to stop his kids fighting in the car, and the crash that follows kills him and his son Phillip.
Brian lies dead after the crash as his wife Alisa and daughter Jessica are rushed away to be saved.

files.notes: Seen only in past scenes (S1 e08, e11 opening; S2 e07). 'Brian' said in S1 e08. S2 step is from the wiki's image of his body at the crash in e07 and Wikipedia's plot; his on-screen presence there is brief. No group named.

add.k: A decorated NYPD officer who murders young dealers
st: Officer Nussbaumer lets Jessica into the crime lab under threat, then hunts Erik and dies when Trish slams him into a wall.

files.notes: 'Officer Carl Nussbaumer' said by Erik in e09.

st: Carlo Eastman plays the cheating husband in Audrey's trap for Jessica, then asks for a divorce once Jessica leaves.

files.notes: 'Carlo' said by Audrey; surname via Audrey Eastman. No group named.

add.k: A well known chef who escaped Sallinger
st: Chef Caspar Marx tells Jessica how Sallinger taped him to a chair, and gives her the address of his old restaurant.

files.notes: Full name said in e06. His restaurant is never named, so Independent.

add.k: A girl taken to Mexico by her father
st: Cassie Yasdan is hauled back from Mexico to her mother by Jessica, telling her Captain America would never do this.

files.notes: Jessica says 'Cassie Yasdan?' in e01. No group.

st: Jeri's new assistant works at her side as Jeri sets up her own firm, Hogarth & Associates.
Char runs Jeri's calls and visitors at Hogarth & Associates, sends Laurent Lyonne in, and fails to keep Jessica out.

files.notes: Unnamed in S2 e13 (credited in AKA Playland, on screen at the new firm); named by Jeri in S3 e01. Last S3 appearance is e13, when Jessica pushes into Jeri's office.

add.k: The bus driver blamed for Reva's death
st: Bus driver Charles Wallace begs Luke for forgiveness when Luke attacks him, and runs as Jessica confesses she killed Reva.

files.notes: Named from the accident file in e02 and by Jessica in e06. 'The MTA covered it up' is said in e06 of his employer, so group MTA (not in groups_in_app).

add.k: A cello teacher once forced to play for Kilgrave
st: Clair tells how Kilgrave made her play her cello for hours, joins the victims' support group, and doubts Robyn's case against Jessica.

files.notes: Name first said in e10 (Robyn lists 'Clair? Emma?'); a 'Cello Lessons by Clair' postcard may show it in e04 but that is unconfirmed, so staged from e10. Group uses the app's existing name for the Kilgrave victims' support group, which she joined in e04 before Malcolm led it.

add.k: A transplant surgeon turned lecturer, hiding from Kilgrave
st: Cornered by Jessica, Dr. Kurata admits Kilgrave forced him to give him Jack Denton's kidneys, revealing anesthesia as his weakness.

files.notes: 'Dr. David Kurata' said in e02. The school he lectures at and his former hospital are not named on screen, so Independent. Flees between e02 and e03 (off screen).

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Albert faces the son he once experimented on and watches him make Louise kill herself. Kilgrave later takes Albert and forces him to strengthen his power, then has his arms cut off.
stages.whoA: His son, who forces him to work
stages.whoB: His father, forced to boost his power

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica brings Albert to face Kilgrave and stops him cutting out his own heart. He tells her why she is immune and dies warning her to kill his son.
stages.whoA: The investigator who stops his suicide
stages.whoB: Kilgrave's father, who explains his power

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Trish takes Albert back to his motel to work on a cure for Kilgrave's power. Will Simpson bursts in on them there.
stages.whoA: Jessica's sister, who helps him work
stages.whoB: Kilgrave's father, working on a cure

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Jessica comes asking about Ana's missing son Nathan, and Ana tries to send her away. Jessica digs under the gazebo and finds Nathan's body.
stages.whoA: The investigator who finds her son
stages.whoB: Nathan Silva's grieving mother

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: A masked Trish breaks into Brandt's apartment to punish him for his sister's beating. He shoots at her and escapes with the sculpture.
stages.whoA: The masked woman who attacks him
stages.whoB: The man who had his sister beaten

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Jessica crashes into Brandt's apartment during Trish's attack. Later she tracks him to his hideout, believes he did not have her stabbed, and leaves him tied up for the police.
stages.whoA: The powered woman who catches him
stages.whoB: The man she leaves for the police

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Dr. Zakarian warns Jeri her symptoms are serious. When Jeri later asks her for drugs to end her life, Zakarian refuses and Jeri calls her useless.
stages.whoA: Her patient, who has ALS
stages.whoB: Her doctor

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Audrey hires Jessica to catch her husband cheating, then springs a trap and shoots her. Jessica trashes the room and scares the couple off.
stages.whoA: The gifted woman she tries to kill
stages.whoB: A client who lures her into a trap

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Audrey and Carlo stage his affair to lure Jessica into a trap. After Jessica leaves, Carlo asks for a divorce.
stages.whoA: Her husband and partner in the ruse
stages.whoB: His wife, who plans the trap

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Barbara and Bob fly in from Omaha together to find their daughter Hope. Hope shoots them both in the elevator.
stages.whoA: Her husband
stages.whoB: His wife

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Barbara hires Jessica to find Hope. When they are reunited, Hope shoots her under Kilgrave's control.
stages.whoA: Her daughter, who shoots her
stages.whoB: Her mother, whom she shoots

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Barbara hires Jessica to find Hope. Jessica brings Hope back, and Barbara dies in the elevator outside Jessica's office.
stages.whoA: The investigator she hires
stages.whoB: The client who hires her to find Hope

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Bob comes to New York to bring Hope home. Hope shoots him under Kilgrave's control.
stages.whoA: His daughter, who shoots him
stages.whoB: Her father, whom she shoots

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Bob tries to fix Jessica's broken door as he and Barbara hire her. Jessica calls him when she finds Hope.
stages.whoA: The investigator he hires
stages.whoB: The client who fixes her door

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Brian takes his family on a trip. He turns to stop Jessica fighting with her brother and crashes.
stages.whoA: His daughter
stages.whoB: Her late father

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Brian dies in the crash. Jessica survives and is rushed away to be saved.
stages.whoA: His daughter, who survives the crash
stages.whoB: Her father, killed in the crash

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Brian and Alisa fight often, a neighbor remembers. Brian is driving when the family car crashes.
stages.whoA: His wife
stages.whoB: Her husband

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Brian is killed in the crash. Alisa survives and wakes years later asking where Brian is.
stages.whoA: His wife, who survives the crash
stages.whoB: Her husband, killed in the crash

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Erik blackmails Nussbaumer over his murders and attacks him in front of Jessica. Nussbaumer hunts Erik down and dies while Erik records his confession.
stages.whoA: His blackmailer
stages.whoB: The corrupt cop he blackmails

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Jessica threatens to expose Nussbaumer unless he gets her into the crime lab. He lets her in and hands her a key card.
stages.whoA: The woman who forces his help
stages.whoB: The corrupt cop she uses

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Trish ambushes Nussbaumer as he hunts Erik and tases him. When he goes for Erik, she slams him into a wall and kills him.
stages.whoA: The masked woman who kills him
stages.whoB: The corrupt cop she kills

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica tails Carlo, not knowing it is a trap. She finds him with Audrey and terrifies them both.
stages.whoA: The investigator he helps trap
stages.whoB: The husband she is hired to follow

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Jessica shows Caspar a photo Sallinger took and tells him Sallinger is a serial killer. He gives her the address of his old restaurant.
stages.whoA: The investigator hunting Sallinger
stages.whoB: The chef who escaped Sallinger

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Jessica finds Cassie in Mexico with her father and takes her back to her mother. Cassie tells her Captain America would never do this.
stages.whoA: The investigator who takes her home
stages.whoB: The runaway she brings back

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Jeri takes on a new assistant as she opens her own firm. The assistant works beside her as the new office is set up.
stages.whoA: Her boss, opening her own firm
stages.whoB: Her new assistant

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Char handles Jeri's calls, visitors and errands at the new firm. She sends in visitors like Laurent Lyonne and tries to keep Jessica out.
stages.whoA: Her boss
stages.whoB: Her assistant

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Malcolm asks Char where Zaya is, and she tells him Zaya is in the new client meeting. She remarks on his black eye.
stages.whoA: A co-worker at the firm
stages.whoB: Jeri's assistant

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Luke rides Charles's bus to the last stop and throws him through the windshield for Reva's death. Charles begs for forgiveness and runs.
stages.whoA: The widower who attacks him
stages.whoB: The driver he blames for Reva

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica holds Luke back and tells Charles to run. She then confesses that she killed Reva.
stages.whoA: The woman who saves him
stages.whoB: The driver she saves from Luke

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Clair hears Malcolm's story when he joins the support group. She thanks him for sharing when he admits hiding Ruben's death.
stages.whoA: Her fellow survivor in the group
stages.whoB: A member of his support group

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Clair tells Jessica her story of Kilgrave and joins the support group. She watches Jessica storm in and out of meetings and does not back Robyn against her.
stages.whoA: The investigator gathering victims
stages.whoB: A victim who tells her story

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Clair tells Jeri and Jessica how Kilgrave made her play her cello. Jeri records the victims' stories.
stages.whoA: The lawyer who records her story
stages.whoB: A victim who comes forward

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica corners Dr. Kurata after his lecture. He tells her about Kilgrave's surgery, and they work out that anesthesia is his weakness.
stages.whoA: The investigator who corners him
stages.whoB: The surgeon who reveals a weakness

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica puts Dr. Kurata on the phone with Jeri. He tells her what Kilgrave made him do.
stages.whoA: The lawyer who hears his story
stages.whoB: The surgeon who backs Hope's case
